edits.hypothesis: Generalizing the instruction to prioritize positive findings from specialized diagnostic tools over negative consensus from general VQA models addresses uncritical acceptance without leaking specific tool names or task IDs.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The agent needs a semantic shift in how it weighs conflicting evidence, which is best achieved through system prompt instructions rather than code logic that might be too rigid.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) In q000002, a specialized tool said 'No' but ground truth was 'Yes'; in q000009, a specialized tool said 'Yes' while others said 'No'. The new prompt instructs prioritizing the specialized positive signal (if present) or re-inspecting pixels if high-res fails. (preservative) Does not disrupt successful direct visual reasoning tasks. (transfer) Generalizes to any domain with specialized vs general tool conflicts.
edits.regression_risk: May cause over-reliance on specialized tools if they hallucinate positives, but the instruction includes 'unless visual inspection clearly contradicts it'.
edits.mechanism: Generalizing the instruction to prioritize positive findings from specialized diagnostic tools over negative consensus from general VQA models addresses uncritical acceptance without leaking specific tool names or task IDs.

edits.hypothesis: Injecting a general instruction into the observation stream when roi_crop fails reinforces the prompt-level heuristic at the point of failure, ensuring the agent sees the guidance when it matters most without referencing specific tool names.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: Prompt edits alone may be forgotten or diluted in long contexts; injecting context at the failure point ensures immediate relevance.
edits.trigger_condition: When roi_crop tool fails with a KeyError or similar infrastructure error.

edits.regression_risk: Adds token overhead to failed steps, but minimal impact on success cases.
